semantic_constraints: Human or model proposals do not themselves authorize execution or activation.
Executable policy applies evidence requirements; the store retains facts and decisions.
Rejected candidates and unsuccessful runs contribute recorded outcomes.
The return path represents feedback into later iterations, not guaranteed promotion.
Model, code, recipe and policy changes use the same bounded cycle.
Capabilities are bound to task-specific recipes; the modality list is not a claim that every model supports every task.
Focus on implementation and intent, without proven/unproven framing or maturity disclaimers.
Use precise authorization, regression monitoring and recovery language.
rendering_constraints: Use one clockwise loop, not two duplicated pipelines.
Route arrows outside labels with visible arrowheads and no crossings.
Keep the recursive-step explanation inside the loop without making it a stage.
Show OvergoDB as a foundation shared across the stages.
Keep text legible at 1200px display width.
Use the JSON as the editable semantic specification and the PNG as its reviewed rendering.

rendering.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset: replacement technical infographic for the Overgo repository README.
Input image 1 is the existing infographic to replace. Redesign its layout and rewrite its text completely using ONLY the exact copy below. Preserve the subject (Overgo's intended recursive self-improvement system), not the old design, density or duplicated pipelines.

Create an exceptionally clear editorial systems diagram, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. It should look like a carefully typeset research overview, neutral and restrained, not a sales pitch. Warm white background, charcoal text, muted teal for the recursive loop, one subtle amber accent for decision. Use generous whitespace, large readable modern sans-serif type, sentence-case titles, small aligned stage numbers, fine flat rules. No shadows, gradients, glossy effects, brain/shield/rocket icons, logos, ornamental charts, or decorative circuitry. No unsupported claims or added words.

LAYOUT AND EXACT COPY:
Top left large title: "Overgo"
Beside or beneath title: "Recursive self-improvement"
Subtitle: "Intent: repeatable gains on fixed tasks within matched resource budgets."

Below header, a slim lightly tinted full-width strip:
"Operator direction"
"Goals, budgets, constraints and stop conditions"
One clear connector enters stage 01 from this strip, without implying that proposals authorize execution.

MAIN DIAGRAM: one dominant, spacious six-stage clockwise loop. Three cards across top, three across bottom. Order and positions must be:
Top left 01 Propose -> top middle 02 Admit -> top right 03 Realize.
Top right 03 down to bottom right 04 Evaluate.
Bottom right 04 -> bottom middle 05 Decide -> bottom left 06 Observe.
Bottom left 06 returns up along the LEFT OUTSIDE EDGE to top left 01.
Connectors are thin teal with clear directional arrowheads, no crossings, never across text. No extra loop or duplicated pipeline.
Each card has exactly these texts:
01 "Propose"
"Human or model"
"Falsifiable change + expected gain"
02 "Admit"
"Check dependencies and authority"
"Bind limits before execution"
03 "Realize"
"Train, compose or edit"
"Run the admitted candidate"
04 "Evaluate"
"Fixed tasks + matched baseline"
"Ablation, quality and resource cost"
05 "Decide"
"Apply executable evidence rules"
"Promote, reject or request more work"
06 "Observe"
"Record outcomes and regressions"
"Quarantine or roll back when required"

In the generous whitespace between the two rows, inside the loop, place an understated two-line explanation:
"The recursive step"
"Outcomes inform later proposals, execution and evaluation policies."
This explanation must be distinct from arrows and not a seventh stage.
A small label beside the outside return connector: "Measured feedback"

Below loop, quiet full-width foundation band:
"OvergoDB | Evidence across every stage"
"Identities and lineage · runs and receipts · metrics and decisions · checkpoints and active versions"
This is a shared durable record; do not draw speculative arrows between random boxes.

Below that band, two balanced text columns, without heavy frames:
Left heading "Change surfaces"
"Models and adapters · recipes and code"
"Data and retrieval · routing and automation policies"
Right heading "Execution substrate"
"Go host + CUDA · serving, training and evaluation"
"Text, image, audio, video, time-series and tabular paths"

Bottom section separated by a fine rule, visibly readable:
"Recursive scope"
"Improve task capability and the mechanisms that propose, execute and evaluate later work."

SEMANTIC CONSTRAINTS:
Focus solely on the implementation and RSI intent. Do not include maturity assessments, proven/unproven framing, or disclaimers.
A model proposes; executable policy admits execution and promotion.
Rejection and failed attempts are still evidence. The loop does not guarantee improvement.
No use of the word safety, no anthropomorphizing evidence as a decision maker, no broad safety promises.
Keep all exact text spelled correctly, strong alignment, ample spacing, comfortably legible when displayed at 1200px wide. Prioritize the main loop and the recursion explanation over subordinate implementation details.
